items: Enter Building. Turn off Alarm

Approve prior days sales, Check e-mails, print rosters for the shift, read notes from previous night, look at last year’s sales and today’s sales projections. Check your ordering calendar to see what orders need to be prepped/placed/received today. Game plan your day.
Check HOH uniforms as they arrive
Complete Prep sheets. Check last night's close. Get aprons and towels.
Count Petty, Bar drawers and To Go drawers. Check for drop bags and prep a change order, if needed.
Check for reservations and EZ Cater for orders. Make a floor plan for the lunch shift.
Check TV schedule for any sports on TV. Assign cable/DirecTV/Apple TV boxes for the day
Coach and Assist as needed in the kitchen.
Turn on TV’s/music
Add any product received to the hot counts sheet. Don’t forget to include any product prepped.
Line Check complete?
Parking lot and any landscaping free of trash?
Check on FOH set up progress
Cooks on the cook line, doors open
Uniform check for FOH team members as they arrive

title: 11:15 - Shift meeting with all FOH
items: Double check uniforms
Review contests, policies, cleaning duties, upsell focus, reviews and secret shopper visits

title: 11:30 - Execute a successful shift.
items: Figure 8 the entire restaurant throughout shift. Checking ticket times, bar guests, bar tickets, touching tables, coaching everyone, giving out High Fives

title: 1:30 - Second prep check and labor check.
items: Follow up with heart of the house on day dots, trash runs, line sweep
Begin cutting labor and checking out servers, checking out cooks.

title: 2:30 - Complete server check outs
items: If team members are turning in signed credit card receipts, compare the credit card tip entered vs what is written

title: 3:00 - Get restaurant CLEAN, SET, READY for the night shift in FOH and Kitchen
items: Product rotated and stocked on the line
Product rotated and stocked behind the bar
Ice is stocked for servers and the bar
Dishes are caught up and put away

title: 3:10 - Meet with closing manager. Go over shift and notes for the day
items: Make sure to review any staffing and product issues for the dinner shift.

title: 3:45 - Check employees clocked in report. Make sure all lunch employees are clocked out.
items: Clock out any team members who need to be clocked out.
Adjust in times and out times, if needed.

title: Hot Counts for the Shift
items: Complete On Hands & PMIX and Enter

title: 4:10 - Make sure all shifts from lunch have been completed
items: Check the open shifts report located in "Manager" on the Toast Handheld

title: 4:30 - Close out lunch shift
items: After all checkouts are completed and turned in, print report.
Distribute tip out and write the tip share on the bottom of the report.
Count the drop and write the total on the bottom of the report also.
Send email/logbook entry –include: Sales $, Labor %, any notes from the shift that need to be passed on accordingly
